lines.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.
Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?
Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!
Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!
Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.
Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!
Excuse me? Ten out of ten?
What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!
No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!
The Chengdu Travel Guide? Wait—did you think I am a hotel inspector?
Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...
Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo. Alone as a greeting, 早！ means a brisk, friendly 'Morning!'.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位经理 ('a manager').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ hòu. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 雨后清晨 ('a morning after rain').

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 雨后的石板路干净得像洗过一样。
examples.trans: After the rain, the flagstones looked freshly washed.

related.gloss: a morning after rain (measure word 场)

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo chén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早晨 ('an early morning').

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 雨后的早晨，院子里全是草木清香。
examples.trans: On a morning after rain, the courtyard is filled with fresh greenery.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qíng lǎng. Describes bright skies after rain.

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 下了一夜雨，今天终于晴朗起来了。
examples.trans: After raining all night, the sky has finally cleared up today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng liáng. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根房梁 ('a roof beam').

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì. Everyday verb for sleeping (睡得好 'sleep well').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个月 ('a month').

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng. Puts warm praise on fragrant tea/bread and even deep, restful sleep (睡得香).

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Describes arriving late or evening time.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。

examples.text: 到明天早上，淋浴喷头的水就会冰凉。

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn dìng. Describes steady water temperature or reliable work.

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

examples.text: 修好热水器后，水温一直很稳定。
examples.trans: Since repairing the heater, the water temperature has stayed steady.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn dài. Describes modern buildings or appliances.

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

examples.text: 老房子外观古朴，里面的浴室却很现代。
examples.trans: The old house looks classic outside, yet its bathrooms are modern.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ xīng jí. Describes luxury hotel service.

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 壶, e.g. 一壶热水 ('a pot of hot water').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

related.gloss: a pot of hot water (measure word 壶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān fáng. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋砖房 ('a brick house').

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 这栋两层老砖房冬暖夏凉。
examples.trans: This two-story old brick house stays warm in winter and cool in summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng lóu. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 最顶楼 ('the top floor').

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 顶楼阁楼有一扇朝南看院子的木窗。
examples.trans: The top-floor attic has a wooden window looking south over the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shí. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 平时日子 ('ordinary days').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it out to guests?

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hén jiǔ. Often follows a verb or precedes 以前.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 我们在站台上等了很久。
examples.trans: We waited on the platform for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯水 ('a glass of water').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

related.gloss: a glass of water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cái. Signals that something happened later than expected or in a small amount—contrast 就.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí dìng. Expresses strong certainty or a warm, firm promise (请一定写下来).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn fēn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个满分 ('a perfect score').

examples.text: 满分十分给九分？！没人会去测量庭院，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Nobody measures courtyards unless...

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn. Counts clock minutes (五分), test/review points (十分), and currency cents.

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu. Surname of Manager Zhou (周经理); as a noun/classifier, means 'week'.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì si. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个意思 ('a meaning').

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
examples.trans: Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xī wàng. Works as both verb ('hope that…') and noun ('hope').

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 希望您今晚在我们客栈睡个好觉。
examples.trans: We hope you sleep soundly at our inn tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué de. Introduces personal impressions or feelings.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 我觉得这间向阳的书房最安静。
examples.trans: I think this sunny study is the quietest room of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn yì. Describes happy guests or hosts.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 客人们对今天的现烤早餐非常满意。
examples.trans: The guests were very pleased with today's freshly baked breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.en: hide the truth from; keep in the dark
meanings.note: Pinyin: mán. Used when keeping a secret from someone.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 我们都是好朋友，别瞒着我。
examples.trans: We are good friends—do not keep me in the dark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān yè. Describes skilled, professional work or a field of study.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 他的声学测量工具非常专业。
examples.trans: His acoustic measuring tools are very professional.

meanings.en: respect deeply; hold in high esteem
meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng zhòng. Warm, respectful verb for admiring elders or teachers.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 整条巷子的街坊都很敬重宋老师。
examples.trans: Neighbors all along the lane deeply respect Teacher Song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǚ yóu. Everyday word for leisure travel.

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ nán. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本指南 ('a guidebook').

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ wéi. Signals a belief that turned out not to be true ('I thought…, but actually…').

examples.text: 成都旅游指南？等等——你们以为我是酒店评审员？
examples.trans: The Chengdu Travel Guide? Wait—did you think I am a hotel inspector?

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家酒店 ('a hotel').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shěn yuán. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位评审员 ('an inspector').

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天晚上 ('last night').

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn zi. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本本子 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜台 ('a counter').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hā hā. Hearty laughter.

examples.text: 哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
examples.trans: Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

examples.text: 哈哈，我们俩想到一块儿去了！
examples.trans: Haha, the two of us had the exact same thought!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五分钟 ('five minutes').

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn zhèng. Attributive adjective ('genuine').

examples.text: 哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
examples.trans: Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

examples.text: 遇到急事的时候，才看得出真正的朋友。
examples.trans: In an emergency, you see who your true friends are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Everyday verb for preparing food, doing work, or making objects.

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!
